title: Past Simple (Negatives and questions) - Past tense interrogatives

options.answer: Did you went to the store yesterday?
Did you go to the store yesterday?
You did go to the store yesterday?

explanation.en: In past simple questions, we use the auxiliary verb 'did' followed by the base form of the main verb ('go').
explanation.ru: В вопросах в Past Simple мы используем вспомогательный глагол 'did' и начальную форму основного глагола ('go').
explanation.uz: Past Simple savol gaplarda 'did' yordamchi fe'lidan keyin asosiy fe'lning boshlang'ich shakli ('go') ishlatiladi.

explanation.en: The negative form of the past simple is 'did not' or 'didn't', followed by the base form of the main verb ('finish').
explanation.ru: Отрицательная форма Past Simple - 'did not' или 'didn't', за которым следует начальная форма основного глагола ('finish').
explanation.uz: Past Simple ning inkor shakli 'did not' yoki 'didn't' bo'lib, undan keyin asosiy fe'lning boshlang'ich shakli ('finish') keladi.

options.answer: Where did they went last night?
Where did they go last night?
Where did they went to last night?

explanation.en: In questions, the auxiliary 'did' is used, and the main verb must be in its base form.
explanation.ru: В вопросах используется вспомогательный глагол 'did', а основной глагол должен быть в начальной форме.
explanation.uz: Savollarda 'did' yordamchi fe'li ishlatiladi va asosiy fe'lning boshlang'ich shakli bo'lishi kerak.

explanation.en: The auxiliary 'did' takes the past tense, so the main verb 'see' must be in its base form.
explanation.ru: Вспомогательный глагол 'did' уже указывает на прошедшее время, поэтому основной глагол 'see' должен быть в начальной форме.
explanation.uz: 'Did' yordamchi fe'li o'tgan zamonni ifodalaganligi sababli, asosiy fe'l 'see' boshlang'ich shaklida bo'lishi kerak.

options.answer: Didn't they come to the party?
Didn't they came to the party?
Did not they came to the party?

explanation.en: The verb 'come' should be in its base form after the auxiliary 'didn't'.
explanation.ru: После вспомогательного глагола 'didn't' глагол 'come' должен быть в начальной форме.
explanation.uz: 'Didn't' yordamchi fe'lidan keyin 'come' fe'li boshlang'ich shaklida bo'lishi kerak.

options.answer: Why did she bought a new phone?
Why she did bought a new phone?
Why did she buy a new phone?

explanation.en: In a question with a question word like 'why', the structure is 'question word + did + subject + base verb'.
explanation.ru: В вопросе с вопросительным словом, таким как 'why', структура такова: 'вопросительное слово + did + подлежащее + начальная форма глагола'.
explanation.uz: 'Why' kabi savol so'zi bilan savol gap tuzilganda, uning tuzilishi 'savol so'zi + did + ega + fe'lning boshlang'ich shakli'dir.

explanation.en: The negative form of the past simple uses 'did not' and the base form of the verb, which is 'eat'.
explanation.ru: Отрицательная форма Past Simple использует 'did not' и начальную форму глагола, которая 'eat'.
explanation.uz: Past Simple inkor shakli 'did not' va fe'lning boshlang'ich shakli 'eat'dan foydalanadi.

explanation.en: After 'did', the verb must be in its base form, which is 'live', not 'lived' or 'lives'.
explanation.ru: После 'did' глагол должен быть в начальной форме, которая 'live', а не 'lived' или 'lives'.
explanation.uz: 'Did'dan keyin fe'l boshlang'ich shaklida bo'lishi kerak, ya'ni 'live', 'lived' yoki 'lives' emas.

explanation.en: The correct negative form for the past simple is 'didn't' followed by the base form of the verb 'watch'.
explanation.ru: Правильная отрицательная форма Past Simple - 'didn't', за которой следует начальная форма глагола 'watch'.
explanation.uz: Past Simple ning to'g'ri inkor shakli 'didn't' bo'lib, undan keyin 'watch' fe'lining boshlang'ich shakli keladi.

options.answer: What did you done with my keys?
What did you do with my keys?
What you did do with my keys?

explanation.en: After the auxiliary verb 'did', the main verb must be in its base form, which is 'do'.
explanation.ru: После вспомогательного глагола 'did' основной глагол должен быть в начальной форме, 'do'.
explanation.uz: 'Did' yordamchi fe'lidan keyin asosiy fe'l boshlang'ich shaklida bo'lishi kerak, ya'ni 'do'.

prompt.en: Fill in the blanks with the correct words.

items.text: My friend and I wanted to go to the new movie, but we ___1___ have enough money. We asked my parents, but they ___2___ want to give us any. I ___3___ understand why. My mom said, '___4___ you not get your allowance last week?' I explained that I ___5___, but I spent it all on a video game. Then she asked, '___6___ you not save any of it?' I said, 'No, I ___7___ save any.' My dad asked, '___8___ you ask your sister for some money?' I told him, 'Yes, I ___9___ ask her, but she ___10___ have any either.' It was a difficult situation. Finally, my dad said, 'Why ___11___ you both not do some chores for money?' I said that was a great idea and we quickly started working. We ___12___ do all the chores, but we did enough to earn the money. We ___13___ go to the movie that night.

explanation.en: This exercise requires the correct use of 'did' for both negative statements and questions in the past simple tense, including 'didn't' for negatives and 'did' for questions and short answers.
explanation.ru: Это упражнение требует правильного использования 'did' как для отрицательных предложений, так и для вопросов в Past Simple, включая 'didn't' для отрицаний и 'did' для вопросов и кратких ответов.
explanation.uz: Ushbu mashq Past Simple zamonidagi inkor gaplar va savollar uchun 'did'ni to'g'ri ishlatishni talab qiladi, shu jumladan 'didn't' inkorlar uchun va 'did' savollar hamda qisqa javoblar uchun.
